objective: Decision 0108, the rules of a shared fight: up to three players' teams in one fight against one crowd that grows with each player; a foe attacks the team it faces; a click strikes the foe nearest its player's team; a wiped team comes back at 25% for the next wave; the boon is voted; a carried player is paid.
acceptance_criteria: An animal's owner (1 to 3) is its player; pack and solitary bonuses stay inside one player's team
The front line is 6, 9 and 12 long for one, two and three players, and each foe in it has a place along it
In a party a foe attacks the team it stands before and a click strikes the standing foe nearest its player's team; with one player nothing changes
LevelRules.enemies(level, players) has PARTY_COUNT times the foes and PARTY_POWER times the power, with one boss
WaveRuns.won gives a player with nobody standing their team back at WIPED_BACK; WaveRuns.tally picks the boon with the most votes and breaks a tie by the run's seed
StationProgress.clear pays a carried player a wave past their own best and makes it their best
verification: lune run tests/run (786 pass); the simulation in decision 0108.
